comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
This skill is more useful than most players can imagine during shipwreck hauling. It make it more clear I will tell what it does:

1) Prevents losing shipspeed while you're hauling a ship.
2) Decreases the likehood that the hauling rope is about to snap (longer lifespan of the hauling rope)
3) With Hauling Assistance on your ship, you get certain % speed up addition. The amount of that is equal to your Haul rank. So at R20 you would get +20% speed up bonus which can be compared with speed up 1, 2, 3 and 4 combined from oxford.

In short, this skill is handy for Shipwreck seekers even if they've Hauling Assistance on their ship. But like Wenzhi said, the haul proficiency will be negated so it is recommended to grind your haul skill from a different ship till it is sufficient enough for you. :-)
